name: Quality Foods Distributing LLC
old_description: Quality Foods Distributing serve as the premier distributor of natural, organic, sustainable and locally-produced products across Montana and the Northern Rockies region. We offer a great selection of the highest quality products, including exceptional regionally made goods that invest in our local talents & economy. We provide consistent, reliable service and support to a wide variety of businesses and institutions.
about:
Quality Foods Distributing is based in Bozeman, Montana. It was founded by Randy and Nancy Lindberg. Randy’s family had acquired a natural products distributor called Nature’s Best in the late 1960s, and he grew that business into the largest privately owned wholesaler‑distributor in the natural products industry. After leaving that company in 2005 and serving as Western Region President for United Natural Foods, Inc., the Lindbergs moved to Bozeman and launched Quality Foods Distributing to provide reliable logistics and distribution for natural, organic, and local foods across Montana and the Northern Rockies.

The company operates as a wholesale distributor, sourcing natural, organic, specialty, and regionally produced foods from local farmers, ranchers, and brands. It manages warehousing, order fulfillment, and delivery logistics for a range of customers, offering on‑time delivery, sales support, and supplier partnership development. The product portfolio includes hundreds of items from producers such as Ghost Town, Kuju, Mission Mountain Eggs, and many other regional brands.

Quality Foods Distributing serves grocery stores, restaurants and coffee shops, universities and hospitals, hotels, lodges, and national parks throughout Montana and the Northern Rockies. Its customer base includes both independent retailers and institutional foodservice operations.

The Lindbergs started the business to fill a gap in reliable distribution for local producers who struggled to reach retail shelves and commercial kitchens. They emphasize consistent, friendly service, expert logistics, and a commitment to investing in the local economy by connecting regional products with regional buyers.
